appDescription.message: This extension allows you to search on YouTube whilst playing a video.

showWelcomeScreenLine.message: You can disable this screen if you want to. You can always re-enable it in the options menu.

notifMessage.message: The extension does not work with AdBlock. If you have problems with using the extension, please try disabling AdBlock. It does work with AdBlock Plus.

bugMessage.message: Do you have trouble using the extension, or found a bug? Please let us know!

contributorsLine.message: A way for us to say 'Thank you' for helping us out!
